entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metal plane with five suns where Mirrans and Phyrexians are in conflict.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The native inhabitants of Mirrodin, including the Myr and vulshok, who fight the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A civilization founded on machines and constant artificial evolution, spreading its contagion across Mirrodin.

entities.name: Phyrexian oil
entities.description: Black glistening substance that spreads the Phyrexian identity code from entity to entity.

entities.name: Myr
entities.description: Creatures that fight for their home plane of Mirrodin.

entities.name: Vulshok
entities.description: A native Mirran people, to which Koth belongs.

entities.name: Vedalken of Lumengrid
entities.description: Knowledge-obsessed researchers who study the Phyrexian oil, including by inoculating elvish test subjects.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Lord of the whispering vault of Ish Sah, who has entangled himself with Phyrexia for his own ends.

entities.name: Nim
entities.description: Geth's minions, cranially-plated necrogen-infected zombies who bring offerings of metal to him.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A vulshok geo-mage and planeswalker native to Mirrodin, dedicated to fighting the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Venser, the Sojourner
entities.description: A planeswalker, artificer and teleportation mage, not from Mirrodin.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker, a new version of Elspeth last seen on Bant.

entities.name: Thrummingbird
entities.description: Mindless birdlike Phyrexian Horrors that carry mutating magic to push infected creatures to the next stage.

entities.name: Quicksilver Sea
entities.description: A sea beyond the Mephidross where Phyrexian oil has been introduced on a large scale.

entities.name: Darkslick
entities.description: The area of the Quicksilver Sea contaminated by Phyrexian oil.

entities.name: Glimmervoid
entities.description: The shining, hex-plated wastes of Mirrodin.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Astral beings native to the Blind Eternities, overwhelming villains able to harvest the life out of entire worlds.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A planeswalker jokingly named as the likely winner in a Phyrexia versus Eldrazi fight.

events.summary: Phyrexian oil pools and passively transmits the Phyrexian contagion to anything that touches it.
events.quote: transmitting the Phyrexian contagion passively to anything that touches it.

events.summary: The vedalken study the Phyrexian oil, including experiments on elvish test subjects.
events.quote: have taken to studying this newfound oily substance.

events.summary: Phyrexian machines corrupt the Quicksilver Sea, creating the Darkslick.
events.quote: the area where this contamination has occurred is called the Darkslick.

events.summary: Geth allows himself to become entangled with Phyrexia, seeing its advance as expedient to his own ends.
events.quote: he sees the advancement of Phyrexia as expedient for his own ends.

events.summary: Geth's nim bring offerings of metal to their master, who uses them to further Phyrexia's cause.
events.quote: bring offerings of metal to their master, which he in turn uses to further Phyrexia's cause.

relations.note: Mirrodin's natives and Phyrexians have opposed goals.
relations.quote: Mirrans and Phyrexians have different goals

relations.note: Koth fights the Phyrexians for his world's survival.
relations.quote: Koth is dedicated to fighting the Phyrexians for the survival of his world

relations.note: Myr fight for their home plane.
relations.quote: Myr fight for their home plane of Mirrodin.

relations.note: Geth acts in his own interests but advances Phyrexia.
relations.quote: has allowed himself to become entangled with the encroaching threat of Phyrexia.
Geth's minions, the trudging, cranially-plated, necrogen-infected zombies known as nim
